shared_visual_rules:
Create ONE portrait 3:4 image, vertical canvas, ideally 1086x1448. This is the artwork for a live casino website provider card, NOT a landscape photo, not a collage, no border or text.
Reference 1 is this individual model's photographic beauty, identity, outfit, fabric texture, lighting, brightness and color-grading source. Reference 2 is ONLY the portrait card layout and framing example; do not inherit its older faces, dark room or clothing. Recompose Reference 1 as a NEW vertical editorial photograph that is purpose-built for the card. Do not simply crop the landscape picture or squeeze/stretch it.
Preserve the same clearly adult early-to-mid-20s woman's beautiful fresh face, hair, wardrobe and luminous fine photographic skin/fabric quality of Reference 1. Same bright premium cream/ivory/champagne casino property, soft natural studio key light, even fill, warm-neutral clean skin tones, subtle blue accents, shallow depth of field. Premium studio fashion-editorial photograph. Fashion beauty leads; room is softly blurred secondary atmosphere. Only baccarat tables for a table source, OR only slot machines for a slot source, no mixed categories and no roulette.
PORTRAIT CARD COMPOSITION: Complete head, headroom about 6%, eyes around 23-26% of height. Face and upper torso centered and large, head-to-upper-hip medium portrait, no distant full-body view. Subject silhouette occupies the middle 80% of width. Reposition arms and relaxed hands inward so shoulders/arms fit the vertical frame gracefully. Vary standing, leaning or seated posture to suit the original outfit, always normal anatomy. No important gesture below 70% height.
LOGO SAFE AREA: bottom 26% is predominantly a simple softly shadowed navy tabletop or smoothly darkened lower foreground. The bright room and bright face remain bright. Keep this lower area visually quiet, no face, elaborate hand gesture, caption or chips there. A provider logo will be overlaid separately in the bottom 156x58px region of the 180x238px card. Do NOT draw any logo or box yourself. The photographer framing should naturally leave clean lower room for that layer.
Every portrait is one independent artwork, all ten belong to a single coherent photo series. Keep refined young beauty and photographic quality, adapt the composition to this actual vertical use.
